title: Per-surface file ownership map
description: Schema for `*-ownership.json` files (one per surface) under reference-index/. Each file lists every source-of-truth path inside that surface and tags it with exactly one engineer-role owner. Generated by reference-index/scripts/generate-<surface>-index.ts; validated in CI by reference-index/ci/check-ownership-coverage.sh.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the file was regenerated. Used to detect stale ownership maps.

scope.description: Repo-rooted directory the ownership map describes. Trailing slash required so it always names a directory, not a file.

surface.description: Optional convenience tag for tooling. Must match the path segment after `apps/` in `scope` when present.

schema_version.description: Schema version this file conforms to. Bump when fields are added or roles are renamed.

owners.description: Optional dictionary of engineer-role metadata (display name, contact, scope description). Keys must match the keys used in `by_owner`.

by_owner.description: Map from engineer-role key to the list of files that role owns. Every file under `scope` MUST appear in exactly one role's list (the 'unassigned' role is permitted as a temporary holding pen, but check-ownership-coverage.sh treats it as a soft warning that fails strict mode).

items.description: Repo-rooted path to a source file. Must start with one of the top-level workspace directories. Trailing slash forbidden — these are files, not directories.

stats.description: Optional aggregate counts produced by the generator. Mirrors are read by the CI scripts so they don't have to recompute.
